system.description: You manifest the presence of your deity. Sustained. You cannot move while it burns, and you cannot lie.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the first pulse strikes as soon as you cast the spell.
outcomes.success: At the start of each of your turns while you sustain the prayer, every foe within 30' takes 3d6 radiant damage.
outcomes.failure: The aura pulses once at the start of your next turn for half damage, then fades.
outcomes.ruin: Your god looks closely at you: you cannot lie until your next Long Rest. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
